description.narrative: 14 Government TVET institutes are offering Entrepreneurship Development Training (EDT) using SYIB to the youths. 1200 youths (25% female) have already received the EDT from these institutes. With the support of European Union Delegation (EUD), ILO developed partnership with the relevant government agencies and TVET institutes in implementing the intervention on EDT. For this ILO developed the capacity of 13 govt. TVET Masters trainers on SYIB manual who trained 60 Trainers to roll out EDT in the TVET institutes.

description.narrative: Bangladesh Small and Cottage Industry (BSCI) used ILO entrepreneurship development training methodology to train 200 entrepreneurs (60% women). Intervention has been designed by ILO with RBSA support which is aimed at capacity building of State-owned entrepreneurship promotion agency, i.e., Bangladesh Small and Cottage Industry (BSCIC).

title.narrative: Output 5.3. Increased capacity of the ILO constituents to design and deliver innovative, flexible and inclusive learning options, encompassing work-based learning and quality apprenticeships

description.narrative:
Seven model TVET institutes (Gaibandha Technical Training Centre; IMT Bagerhat; Bangladesh-Sweden Polytechnic institute Rangamati; Feni Polytechnic Institute; Jamalpur Technical School and College, Sylhet Technical School and College and Khulna Mahila Polytechnic Institute) became Registered Training Organizations (RTO) and have improved capacity to offer skills training, assessment (in certificate courses and recognition of prior learning-RPL), and employment support service to youths from different social groups. In 2020-21, 2,159 youths have been assessed through RPL and 2,249 youths (30% female) completed their training in certificate courses (65% are engaged in jobs).
The Technical Teachers' Training Centre (TTTC) Dhaka and Vocational Teachers' Training Institute (VTTI) Bogura are working as "Centre for Skills Excellence" (CSEs) and provide training and assessment services to trainers and assessors. A total of 1,922 (30% women) trainers and assessors completed their Competency-based training and assessment - Level 4 training.
VTTI Bogura trained 555 TVET officials on Online training material development. They subsequently developed 176 online learning contents. The ILO provided technical and implementation support to the 7 MTIs and 2 CSEs through teachers' and assessors' training, developing and implementing quality improvement plans, an inclusion strategy, and a greening guideline. The institutions also established Institutional Management Advisory Boards, Employers' Forum, Business Incubation centres, Instructional material development centres, career guidance and job placement cells.
The ILO supported VTTI Bogura for the training of teachers on online training material development and delivery of e-learning contents with video lectures and supplementary materials.

title.narrative: 5.3.2. Number of member States with innovative, flexible and inclusive skills programmes and services targeting women, youth or persons in vulnerable situations
Output 5.2. Increased capacity of member States to strengthen skills and lifelong learning policies, governance models and financing system

description.narrative:
The National Skills Development Policy (NSDP) 2021, aligned with the Bangladesh National Qualification Frameworks (BNQF), has been approved by the Executive Committee (EC) of the National Skills Development Authority (NSDA). NSDA prepared a National Skills Action Plan (2021-25) to implement the NSDP 2021. With support from the European Union, the ILO developed the capacity of NSDA to draft the NSDP 2021 and the National Skills Action Plan (2021-25).
The ILO trained 100 TVET officials (12% female), including principals, managers, instructors and trainers) on policy dialogue; 53 of them received advanced training on policy review and analysis.
The ILO developed the capacity of around 200 TVET officials (35% female) in partner TVET institutes on the NSDP and published six policy recommendation documents from policy dialogues and training events.
